557:t_018:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm coming through, $$レナード$$! If only to get to $$千鳥$$!!」

557:t_019:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「I can't understand what you people are thinking.」

557:t_019:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are you talking about us getting in the way of your plan!?」

557:t_019:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「You're telling us to accept something that'll get people killed all over the world!?」

557:t_019:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「Spare me the official line. Let me hear what you really think.」

557:t_019:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Deep down, you hate them, don't you? You curse them? Your own fates... this very world.」

557:t_019:6.en:
$$レナード$$
「I did have you people looked into, after all.」

557:t_019:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「Those who lost the people dear to them and regret their own pasts...」

557:t_019:12.en:
$$レナード$$
「Those who despair of the future and fear what's to come...」

557:t_019:16.en:
$$レナード$$
「Those who carry their anxiety and want to run away from this very moment...」

557:t_019:19.en:
$$レナード$$
「If you sided with me, I could free you from all of that.」

557:t_019:20.en:
$n
「...Figures, coming from a guy riding a machine like $$ベリアル$$. That's the whisper of a devil.」

557:t_019:22.en:
$$レナード$$
「I wasn't asking you, $$テレサ$$. I'm appealing to each person's heart, one by one.」

557:t_019:25.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Fine. But even if you don't side with me, if you at least let the spacetime repair go by, there are benefits in it for you.」

557:t_019:27.en:
$$レナード$$
「Mental contamination by the Iota waves... Because of that, the $$新地球皇国$$ will effectively perish as well.」

557:t_019:29.en:
$$レナード$$
「Though the Empire's Reactors will probably survive, of course.」

557:t_019:30.en:
$$レナード$$
「The same goes for you people. Anyone with a strong enough will won't be swallowed by the Iota waves.」

557:t_019:31.en:
$$レナード$$
「But the so-called ordinary citizens and the Empire's small fry will be finished, I'd say.」

557:t_019:32.en:
$$レナード$$
「With this, we can overturn the gap in numerical strength. All that's left is to gather the strong humans who remain and take back Earth.」

557:t_019:33.en:
$$万丈$$
「Your logic sounds as if it's fine so long as only the strong survive.」

557:t_019:34.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's exactly what I meant. If they aren't that kind of person, they could never face the future of despair ahead.」

557:t_020:2.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$ズール$$! And the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ too!」

557:t_020:4.en:
$$竜馬$$
「What the hell did you come here for!?」

557:t_020:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「We came to watch mere Wingless use the power of a god.」

557:t_020:6.en:
$$ズール$$
「Trying to use that power without ascending to the seat of the gods...」

557:t_020:7.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Earthlings really are a warped species.」

557:t_020:8.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「It must all be the guidance of $$オリジン・ロー$$.」

557:t_020:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A god... no, a higher-dimensional life form...!」

557:t_020:10.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You seem to have gained a little knowledge.」

557:t_021:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Evil gods. You are underestimating the power of Earthlings.」

557:t_021:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「It's been a while, $n. Your growth is most gratifying.」

557:t_021:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What do you want, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

557:t_021:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「Are you here to gawk too, just like the bosses of those villains!」

557:t_021:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「My purpose differs from theirs somewhat. I came to encourage him, the one who is about to use the power of a god.」

557:t_021:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Do as you please. The sight of you resisting the future of despair is even beautiful.」

557:t_021:8.en:
$$ズール$$
「If you avert your eyes from the truth, so be it.」

557:t_021:9.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「We will take this planet once your spacetime repair is complete.」

557:t_021:10.en:
$$ハーデス$$
「Until then, go on killing each other, you half-formed species that will never reach the seat of the gods.」

557:t_022:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「They came, said whatever they pleased, and left!」

557:t_022:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$... You are...」

557:t_022:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Until now... and from now on as well, I am on your side.」

557:t_022:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'll be waiting. For the day you fight alongside me.」

557:t_023:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「What in the world are those guys...!」

557:t_023:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「They probably just came out of pure curiosity. To see me, the one who chose a different path from theirs.」

557:t_023:4.en:
$$レナード$$
「Who knows... I'll leave dealing with them to you.」

557:t_023:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「Kill each other to your hearts' content in the world after our spacetime repair is finished.」

557:t_023:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't think we'll allow a world like that!」

557:t_024:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「Ngh...! You're saying this $$ベリアル$$ lost...!?」

557:t_024:2.en:
$$レナード$$
「Don't presume you've won on your own, $$相良$$!」

557:t_025:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「It wasn't you that $$ベリアル$$ lost to. It was $c!」

557:t_025:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「And even if the AS is lost, that doesn't mean I'm finished!」

557:t_025:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「Knowing you, I figured you wouldn't admit defeat unless the man you look down on finished you off completely.」

557:t_025:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「You seem to understand me a little.」

557:t_025:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「There's something else I know about you.」

557:t_025:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「I heard it from $$テッサ$$. She knows what your mother did.」

557:t_020:5: Mikage's subject is elided; rendered 'We came' (plural, answering Ryouma's plural question) - scene implies Mikage/Xul/Hades together
557:t_019:35: Zero's 'those words' left as 'those words' - referent (Leonard's 'future of despair'/strong-survive phrase?) is not settled by the scene
uncertain: 557:t_019:25: 時空修復を見送れば rendered 'let the spacetime repair go by' (i.e. not oppose it); could also mean 'put the repair off/forgo it'; the benefit explained next (Iota-wave contamination) suggests Leonard means letting it proceed
557:t_019:35: referent of その言葉 (Zero) unknown - kept vague
557:t_025:5: 母親 rendered 'your mother' (Leonard's and Tessa's shared mother; next slice's 'Mother denied my existence' supports Leonard's mother)
557:t_021:5: 彼 (the one about to use a god's power) taken as Leonard, since Xul/Mikage refer to him as the Wingless using a god's power; he is male per glossary
557:t_019:20: ベリアル token used for the machine; 'devil's whisper' fits Belial being a demon
557:t_020:5: 翅無し = 'Wingless' (Aquarion rule) used as a plural noun
557:t_019:29/31: リアクター = 'Reactors' (capitalized, as in earlier slices); 雑魚共 = 'small fry'
